personalised_offer.subject_line: Unlock Your Potential: Personalised Offer Just for You
personalised_offer.message_body:
Hi there, 

I hope this message finds you well! I noticed that over the past 9 months with us, your engagement with our product has been quite low, and I completely understand that it can be challenging to see the value when the features remain partially unexplored. 

Your current usage pattern, with login activity at 0.3 times a week and a feature usage score of just 8 out of 100, suggests there might be more opportunities to enhance your experience and derive greater value from the platform. With just a little more engagement, you could unlock impactful tools designed to streamline your tasks and boost productivity. 

To help you experience this potential first-hand, I’d like to offer you a guided path towards an upgrade with your first month on the Starter plan completely free. This opportunity allows you to explore features that are closely aligned with your needs without any immediate financial commitment. 

Looking forward to hearing from you! Let's set up a time to discuss how we can tailor our platform to your specific needs.
personalised_offer.offer_details: Upgrade to the Starter plan and enjoy the first month free. Experience features more aligned with your needs, plus a guided introduction to maximise benefits.
personalised_offer.call_to_action: Please reply to this email or book a call with me to discuss upgrading your plan and starting your first month free.

evaluation_result.feedback: The message is generally well-crafted with a good level of personalization and non-generic language. However, it could be improved by detailing more about the Starter plan benefits that align with the user's low engagement areas.
